description: This PHP script handles the deletion of a device in the inventory list of the TestLink project. It initializes required parameters, checks user permissions, performs deletion if authorized, and returns the operation result as a JSON response.

classes.name: tlInventory
classes.description: A class responsible for managing inventory items, including deletion and providing user feedback.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments related to device deletion, including test project ID and user ID.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to manage project inventory.
